paper.title: Performance of the MACE-MP-0 potential for calculating viscosity in LiF molten salt.

result.summary: 本文用分子动力学模拟研究了熔融 LiF 的粘度，比较了 MACE-MP-0（small）机器学习势与经典 Buckingham、Born-Huggins-Mayer 势的表现 [abstract][S2.p1]。作者采用 Green-Kubo 方法从应力自相关函数计算粘度，并与实验值对比 [S2.p1][S2.p3]。结果显示 MACE-MP-0 开箱即用即可在整个液态范围内较好地重现实验粘度，而经典势预测的粘度偏低，且其熔点被低估约 300 K [abstract][S3.p1][S3.p2]。作者还发现 MACE 通过简单加热晶体结构得到的熔点显著更接近 LiF 的实验熔点 [abstract][S3.p2]。

research_question.text: 论文旨在评估 MACE-MP-0 机器学习势在计算熔融 LiF 粘度方面的准确性，并与经典 Buckingham 和 BHM 势进行对比 [S1.p4][abstract]。研究动机来自熔盐在太阳能电池、电解质、核反应堆冷却剂及燃料载体等领域的应用需求，而经典原子模型在生成可靠热物理数据方面存在不足 [S1.p1][S1.p2]。粘度是决定热工水力工作流体性能的关键性质，此前经典势预测的 LiF 粘度存在明显的温度偏移 [S1.p3]。

evidence.quote: Motivated by these applications and a desire to improve the MD picture of molten LiF we now turn to the rapidly growing field of machine-learnt interatomic potentials (MLIPs).
Here we report the accuracy of viscosity values calculated using the MACE potential against experimental viscosity data.

Molten salts such as LiF have received long term and recent interest due to their use in solar cells, as electrolytes and solvents, and potential utilisation as coolant fluids in nuclear reactors, along with metals.

A thorough understanding of the thermodynamic and transport properties of molten salts and their mixtures will underlie the upscaling of the above processes to industrial scales, however this understanding is hindered by a poor theoretical understanding of the liquid state, and the inadequacy of classical atomistic models in generating faithful thermophysical data.

Viscosity is one key property governing the performance of working fluids in thermal hydraulics, which has been investigated theoretically in relation to its temperature dependent minimum that may be related to fundamental physical constants.

Previously we investigated this minimum in LiF using classical molecular dynamics (MD) where, as found elsewhere, the Buckingham potential model of molten LiF predicts the viscosity at a noticeable off-set temperature.

method.text: 作者使用经典分子动力学（DL_POLY 包，Buckingham 和 BHM 势）以及 MACE 机器学习势（通过 janus-core 包，MACE_MP_0 small 版本）模拟熔融 LiF [S2.p1]。粘度通过 Green-Kubo 方法从应力张量自相关函数的积分计算 [S2.p1]。模拟采用 NVE 系综，时间步长 1 fs，轨迹长度 1 ns，对 20 个独立初始构型取平均；平衡阶段在 NPT 系综中从晶体结构逐步加热 [S2.p2]。系统尺寸为 N=512 原子，MACE 模型基于 MPNN 架构，训练于 MPtrj 数据集 [S2.p3][S2.p5]。

evidence.quote: We perform MD simulations of molten LiF using classical MD (using the Buckingham and BHM potentials), via the DL_POLY package, and MACE MLIP, via the python package janus-core using MACE_MP_0 (small flavour).
In both cases we use the Green-Kubo method to calculate viscosity from the integral

For all statistics collection simulations we use the NVE ensemble with a timestep of 1 fs and a trajectory length of 1 ns, and average across 20 initial configurations each independently initialised with the same density.
For equilibration we heat the system in the NPT ensemble from a crystal lattice structure taking temperature steps from 10 K to the desired temperature in steps of 50 K.

In both we use a system size of N=512 atoms, where we have previously found little impact on results from utilising large system sizes up to 100000 atoms for classical potentials in LiF and Argon systems.

The MACE model relies upon a Message Passing Neural-Network (MPNN) architecture where the input space is the dynamic local environment around any given atom along with its static properties (e.g. chemical element).
The model is trained upon the MPtrj data set introduced for CHGNet and compiled from the Material Project dataset, which includes 89 elements (including Li and F) in ~146,000 materials.

experiments.text: 作者在熔融 LiF 体系上比较了 MACE、Buckingham 和 BHM 三种模型计算的粘度与实验数据，温度范围覆盖熔点以上 [S3.p1][S3.F1]。通过从晶体结构逐步单调加热至 1250 K 来观察体积变化以确定熔点 [S3.p2][S3.F2]。还计算了速度自相关函数（VAF）和态密度（DOS），分别在 Buckingham 熔点 890 K 和 MACE 熔点 1147 K 附近比较动力学 [S3.p4][S3.F3]。此外计算了部分径向分布函数 g(r) 和结构因子 S(k) [S3.p5][S3.F4][S3.F5]。

evidence.quote: We begin by comparing the viscosity measurements from the three computational models to experimental data in Figure 1.
To investigate this, in Figure 2 we show the system volume V for the MACE, Buckingham, and BHM models following a gradual monotonic heating from a crystal structure up to 1250 K.
First we show the velocity autocorrelation functions (VAFs) of the Buckingham and MACE models in figure 3, with the resultant densities of states (DOS) of each included as insets.
The temperatures of 890 K and 1147 K were chosen to compare the VAFs just above the melting points of the Buckingham and MACE potentials respectively.
Next we look at the partial RDFs g(r) in Figure 4, and the structure factors derived from them in Figure 5.
Figure 5: S(k) calculated at from the partial RDFs using 1000 MACE trajectory frames at 1147 K.

findings.text: MACE 模型计算的粘度在整个温度轴上与实验数据吻合良好，而 Buckingham 和 BHM 模型存在已知的温度偏移，模拟粘度在约高 300 K 的温度下才与实验值匹配 [S3.p1]。MACE 模拟的熔点与实验熔点吻合良好，支持了经典势粘度偏移与其低估熔点约 300 K 相关的观点 [S3.p2]。VAF 分析显示 MACE 模拟中 Li 和 F 原子的振荡频率降低，VAF 极小值更深且两者形状相似，表明液体运动具有更明显的类固态振荡成分 [S3.p4]。RDF 分析表明 MACE 模拟的配位环境更宽，但平均结构相似而动力学和输运性质可显著不同 [S3.p5][S3.p6]。

evidence.quote: The results for the MACE model agree well with the experimental data across the temperature axis, unlike the known offset for the Buckingham and BHM models: the simulated viscosity matches the experimental viscosity well, albeit with the latter at a temperature around 300 K higher.
We observe good agreement between the experimental melting temperature and the melting temperature of the MACE simulation.

This supports this notion that the poor reproduction of the experimental viscosity in simulations governed by the Buckingham and BHM models is related to the underestimation of the the melting temperature by approximately 300 K, ascertained in experiments to be 1121 K (although 1143 K is also recorded).
We see a decrease of the well known oscillatory frequency of F and particularly Li atoms in the MACE simulation.
Both Li and F atoms exhibit a much deeper minima in the MACE VAFs, approximately equal in magnitude.
In this sense, deeper minima in MACE systems imply more pronounced solidlike component of the liquid motion.

The reduction in magnitude indicates a somewhat broader coordination environment simulated by the MACE model than the classical model, which may be related to the lower frequency oscillation of the Li ions in the MACE simulation.
An interesting insight from the RDF analysis is that average structures can be quite similar, yet dynamics and transport properties can differ substantially as we saw for viscosity results earlier.

limitations.text: 作者指出，分子模拟中熔点的确定受多种因素影响，例如周期性边界条件导致没有自由表面或界面，以及小系统尺寸缺少长波长低频声子，因此从晶体结构逐步加热的方法可能并不普遍准确 [S3.p3]。MACE 势确定熔点的性能可用自由能计算或相共存模拟等方法测试，但本文的目标和重点是计算和预测粘度而非准确确定熔点，这留待未来研究 [S3.p3]。此外，由于计算时间和资源的限制，使用 MACE-MP-0 增大系统尺寸以观察 g(r) 趋于 1 并不实际 [S3.p5]。作者还提到，虽然结果支持熔点低估导致粘度偏移的假说，但系统尺寸和缺乏界面等其他效应仍可能起作用 [S4.p2]。

evidence.quote: For these and other reasons, gradual heating from a crystal structure might not be generally accurate for determining the melting point and other methods such as calculating the free energies of solid and liquid phases, simulating phase co-existence and so on can be used instead.

The performance of MACE potentials for determining the melting point can be tested using these approaches, however the goal and emphasis of this work is the calculation and prediction of transport properties such as viscosity rather than determining the melting point accurately which is a task for future investigations.
For the computational time and power we have available this is not practical with MACE-MP-0.
Our results lend some credence to that hypothesis, but it remains possible other effects such as system size and the lack of interfaces may contribute.
